-- Phase 2: implementations. Contracts and signatures are unchanged.

-- True when every element of xs appears exactly once.
distinct(xs: List[int]) -> bool =
  ex distinct([1, 2, 3]) == True
  ex distinct([1, 1]) == False
  for i in range(0, xs.len())
    for j in range(i + 1, xs.len())
      if xs[i] == xs[j]
        return False
  True

-- Returns n distinct record ids. The same seed always gives the same ids.
make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre n >= 0
  post out.len() == n
  post distinct(out)
  ex make_ids(0, 7) == []
  ex make_ids(3, 7) == make_ids(3, 7)
  -- Linear congruential generator modulo 2^31. The multiplier and increment
  -- give the full period, so the states are distinct. Products stay below
  -- 2^62, so nothing overflows. Floor modulo keeps a negative seed in range.
  var ids: List[int] = []
  var state = seed % 2147483648
  while ids.len() < n
    state = (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648
    ids.append(state)
  ids
